x: In the absence of Rice the Two Miles went to Hunter in 9.20, with veteran McCluskey doing 9.25. The High Jump and Pole Vault went at 6ft. 6in. and 14ft. respectively.

Hunter, Robertson, Bailey and Harry Turner are new members as Seniors and Jim Purdy and Pete Hunt two promising Juniors. We have of course lost some of our Juniors to the Services, but there are a number of new ones to take their places.

Southend’s Ben Hunter, second in the SEAA Champs, was pushing the pace along but Nick looked very comfortable alongside Mitch Goose of City of Norwich with Ronnie Sparke (SEAA winner) from Woodford, Winchester’s Phil Bernsten (SEAA 4th) and James Wilkinson of Leeds tagging along at the back.
